content.short: HeyMint helps creators build allowlists and manage collectors.
content.description: HeyMint's allowlist manager enables creators to set detailed criteria for who may join their list, while adding security features to protect both creators and collectors. For collectors, the platform keeps you informed about new projects joining the community, shows upcoming allowlists, and makes it easy to track your submissions through the dashboard. HeyMint provides cross-chain support for Ethereum, Solana, Polygon, Arbitrum, OP Mainnet, BNB Chain, and Avalanche.
content.meta: HeyMint helps creators build allowlists with precise requirements and security features. Discover HeyMint and other NFT Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
